Specification of Diagnostics
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
7.3.3.5.4 SOVD API – Faults
[SWS_DM_01418]
SOVD
faults
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04259
⌈
Each
DiagnosticTroubleCodeUds
shall express a SOVD fault.
⌋
[SWS_DM_01417] Support of
SOVD
method
Read Faults from an Entity
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04259, RS_Diag_04258
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall support the SOVD method
Read
Faults from an Entity
if a
DiagnosticSovdFaultMemoryAccess
references
a
DiagnosticSovdMethod
and the corresponding
DiagnosticSovdMethod.get
attribute exists.
⌋
[SWS_DM_01416] Support of
SOVD
method
Read Details for a Fault
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04259
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall support the SOVD method
Read De-
tails for a Fault
if a
DiagnosticSovdFaultMemoryAccess
references a
DiagnosticSovdMethod
and the corresponding
DiagnosticSovdMethod.get
attribute exists.
⌋
[SWS_DM_01415]
SOVD
fault general attributes
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04259
⌈
The SOVD attributes
code
,
scope
,
display_code
,
fault_name
,
severity
of a
SOVD fault shall be derived according to [SWS_DM_01567].
⌋
[SWS_DM_02120] Response Body for
SOVD
fault attributes
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04259
⌈
The DM shall map the following data to a SOVD fault attributes response body as
listed in table [SWS_DM_01567].
⌋

SOVD
fault attributes table
